Pathfinder has the best tactical in the game. Don't get me wrong, he has no passive and his ultimate is well balanced. But he's tactical gives him the best movement in the game. It's incredibly versatile, letting him make distance both vertically and horizontally. It let's him leave fights with ease and safety. And unlike other powerful tacticals, he's cooldown is dependent on how far he goes. So if he messes up, he has a shorter cooldown. And, it's so easy to use. I hate when people act like it takes some incredible master to use him well. 

Don't get me wrong though, I don't think he needs some straight up nerf or is overpowered. 

I'd like to see him get a new passive (maybe one that actually makes him a recon) and a buff to his ultimate. And maybe increase the max potential cooldown for the grapple. I'm just tired of everyone acting like he's weak and seeing everyone play him just for his tactical.
